```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

cb <- function(df) {
  kable(df, col.names = c("Variable", "Type", "Range / Values", "Description", "Notes"),
        align = c("l","c","c","l","l")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                  full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13)
}
```

---

## Overview

This codebook covers all measured variables across three oTree apps:

| App | oTree name | Purpose |
|-----|-----------|---------|
| `experiment_discussion` | `main` | Consent, LLM interview, pre-discussion opinion |
| `experiment_matching` | `matching` | Wait page, condition assignment, DeliberateLab redirect |
| `experiment_post_survey` | `post_survey` | Post-discussion surveys (opinion, conversation, PANAS, facilitator, affect, AI attitudes, open feedback) |

**Export columns** follow the oTree wide-format convention:
`{app_name}.1.player.{field}` — e.g. `experiment_discussion.1.player.opinion_pre`

**Linking key across apps:**

| Field | Where stored | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `participant.code` | oTree participant | Auto-generated oTree ID; used as `external_id` sent to DeliberateLab |
| `participant.label` | Post-survey participant | Set by DL redirect; format `{pre_code}___{topic_id}___{condition}___{dl_public_id}___{cohort_name}` |
| `cloudresearch_pid` | Pre-survey player | Self-reported CloudResearch ID entered on consent page |
| `dl_public_id` | Post-survey player | DeliberateLab anonymous participant ID (e.g. `hamster-yellow-3762`) |
| `pre_survey_code` | Post-survey player | oTree `participant.code` from the pre-survey session, recovered from DL redirect |

---

## Session-level variables

These are set once per session in `experiment_discussion` and available to all apps.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var  = c("session.topic_id", "session.topic_label", "session.topic_statement",
           "session.topic_category", "session.topic_category_label",
           "session.topic_is_political",
           "session.topic_position_a", "session.topic_position_b",
           "session.pairs_matched"),
  type = c("String","String","String","String","String","Boolean","String","String","Integer"),
  range = c("e.g. '001'","—","—","e.g. 'health_policy'","—","TRUE / FALSE","—","—","≥ 0"),
  desc = c(
    "Unique topic ID from discussion_topics.json",
    "Short topic label shown to participants",
    "Full topic statement used as discussion prompt",
    "Topic category code",
    "Human-readable category label",
    "Whether the topic is classified as political",
    "Label for the left/low end of the opinion slider",
    "Label for the right/high end of the opinion slider",
    "Running count of successfully matched pairs in this session"
  ),
  notes = rep("", 9)
))
```

---

## Participant-level fields

Stored on the oTree participant object; available in all apps via `participant.vars`.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var  = c("participant.code", "participant.cloudresearch_id", "participant.condition",
           "participant.opinion_pre", "participant.opinion_post",
           "participant.is_matched", "participant.is_dropout",
           "participant.dl_url", "participant.dl_public_id",
           "participant.pre_survey_code", "participant.interview_transcript"),
  type = c("String","String","String","Integer","Integer","Boolean","Boolean",
           "String","String","String","JSON String"),
  range = c("Auto","—","4 levels","0–100","0–100","TRUE/FALSE","TRUE/FALSE","URL","—","—","—"),
  desc = c(
    "oTree auto-generated participant ID; used as external_id in DL redirect",
    "CloudResearch participant ID entered on consent page",
    "Between-subjects condition assigned at matching",
    "Pre-discussion opinion on the topic (0 = fully agree with position A, 100 = position B)",
    "Post-discussion opinion on the topic",
    "Whether the participant was successfully matched with a partner",
    "Whether the participant timed out before being matched",
    "Full DeliberateLab cohort URL assigned to this participant",
    "DeliberateLab anonymous participant ID recovered from post-survey redirect",
    "oTree participant.code from the pre-survey, recovered from post-survey redirect",
    "Full LLM interview transcript as a JSON array of question–answer objects"
  ),
  notes = c("","","control_ai, control_human, bridging_ai, bridging_human",
            "Collected in experiment_discussion","Collected in experiment_post_survey",
            "","","","","Links pre and post survey records","")
))
```

## App 1: experiment_discussion

### Consent & identification

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = c("experiment_discussion.1.player.consent",
            "experiment_discussion.1.player.cloudresearch_pid"),
  type  = c("Boolean", "String"),
  range = c("TRUE / FALSE", "—"),
  desc  = c("Whether the participant provided informed consent",
            "CloudResearch participant ID as self-reported on consent page"),
  notes = c("Participants who do not consent are redirected to a NoConsent page and do not proceed",
            "Required only when consent = TRUE; copied to participant.cloudresearch_id")
))
```

### LLM interview

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = c("experiment_discussion.1.player.interview_test",
            "experiment_discussion.1.player.conversation_json",
            "experiment_discussion.1.player.interview_transcript"),
  type  = c("String", "JSON String", "JSON String"),
  range = c("—", "—", "—"),
  desc  = c(
    "Text or transcription from the voice/microphone test page",
    "Full interview conversation stored as a JSON array; updated after each turn",
    "Final copy of conversation_json saved at end of interview"
  ),
  notes = c(
    "",
    "Each element: {question, answer, input_mode, time_sent, time_received}",
    "Identical to conversation_json at completion; also mirrored to participant"
  )
))
```

### Pre-discussion opinion

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = "experiment_discussion.1.player.opinion_pre",
  type  = "Integer",
  range = "0–100",
  desc  = "Participant's opinion on the discussion topic before the conversation (slider). 0 = fully agrees with position A; 100 = fully agrees with position B.",
  notes = "Mirrored to participant.opinion_pre for use in matching"
))
```

## App 2: experiment_matching

The matching app has **no player-level fields** in the database. All outcomes are stored on the participant object (see [Participant-level fields] above).

### Condition assignment

Conditions are assigned at matching using a balanced shuffled queue. Each matched pair is assigned one condition.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = "participant.condition",
  type  = "String",
  range = "4 levels",
  desc  = "Between-subjects experimental condition assigned at matching",
  notes = ""
))

kable(data.frame(
  Value = c("control_ai", "control_human", "bridging_ai", "bridging_human"),
  Facilitator = c("AI", "Human (confederate)", "AI", "Human (confederate)"),
  Strategy = c("Control (no active facilitation)", "Control (no active facilitation)",
               "Bridging intervention", "Bridging intervention")
), align = "l") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
cb(data.frame(

            "experiment_post_survey.1.player.topic_id",

            "experiment_post_survey.1.player.topic_position_b"),
  type  = c("String","String","String","String","String","String","Boolean","String","String"),
  range = rep("—", 9),
  desc  = c(
    "oTree participant.code from the pre-survey session (links pre and post records)",
    "DeliberateLab anonymous participant ID",
    "Discussion topic ID (links to session topic fields)",
```

### Manipulation check

```{r}
cb(data.frame(

  type  = c("String", "Integer"),
```

### Post-discussion opinion

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = "experiment_post_survey.1.player.opinion_post",
  type  = "Integer",
  range = "0–100",
  desc  = "Participant's opinion on the discussion topic after the conversation (slider). 0 = fully agrees with position A; 100 = fully agrees with position B.",
  notes = "Mirrored to participant.opinion_post"
```

### Conversation quality (1–5 Likert)

Scale: 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var = c("experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_satisfied",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_feeling_heard",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_voice",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_understanding",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_receptiveness",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_respect",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.conv_future_engage"),
  type  = rep("Integer", 7),
  range = rep("1–5", 7),
  desc  = c(
    "Overall, I am satisfied with this conversation.",
    "I felt heard and understood by my partner.",
    "I was able to communicate my values and beliefs to my partner.",
    "By the end, I felt I understood the other person's perspective.",
    "The other person engaged with my arguments rather than dismissing them.",
    "The other person treated me with respect.",
    "I would participate in another conversation on this platform."
  ),
  notes = c("Overall satisfaction","Feeling heard","Voice / psychological safety",
            "Understanding the other person","Good faith / receptiveness","Respect",
            "Future engagement")
))
```

### I-PANAS-SF — Affect during conversation (1–5)

International Positive and Negative Affect Schedule — Short Form (Thompson, 2007).
Scale: 1 = Not at all, 5 = Extremely. Items presented in the order listed below.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var = c("experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_upset",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_hostile",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_alert",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_ashamed",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_inspired",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_nervous",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_determined",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_attentive",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_afraid",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.panas_active"),
  type  = rep("Integer", 10),
  range = rep("1–5", 10),
  desc  = c("Upset","Hostile","Alert","Ashamed","Inspired",
            "Nervous","Determined","Attentive","Afraid","Active"),
  notes = c(rep("Negative affect", 2), "Positive affect", "Negative affect", "Positive affect",
            "Negative affect", rep("Positive affect", 3), "Negative affect", "Positive affect")
))
```

### Facilitator evaluation (1–5 Likert)

Scale: 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree. `fac_intrusiveness` is reverse-coded.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var = c("experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_warmth",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_competence",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_legitimacy",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_fairness",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_intrusiveness",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_eff_understanding",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_eff_civility",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_eff_constructive",
          "experiment_post_survey.1.player.fac_willingness"),
  type  = rep("Integer", 9),
  range = rep("1–5", 9),
  desc  = c(
    "The facilitator seemed warm and understanding.",
    "The facilitator understood the situation well.",
    "These are the kind of messages that this facilitator should be allowed to write.",
    "The way the facilitator intervened was fair.",
    "The facilitator's intervention felt disruptive to the conversation.",
    "This facilitator message would help the people in the conversation understand each other better.",
    "This facilitator message would improve the tone of the conversation.",
    "This intervention made the conversation more productive.",
    "I would participate in a community that used this kind of facilitator."
  ),
  notes = c("Warmth","Competence","Legitimacy","Fairness",
            "Intrusiveness — reverse-coded",
            "Effectiveness – Understanding","Effectiveness – Civility",
            "Effectiveness – Constructiveness","Willingness to engage")
))
```

### Facilitator preference

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = c("experiment_post_survey.1.player.pref_support",

  range = c("1–5", "4 levels"),
  desc  = c(

  ),
  notes = c("1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree",
```

### Affect toward partner

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = "experiment_post_survey.1.player.affect_warmth",
  type  = "Integer",
  range = "0–100",
  desc  = "Feeling thermometer: how warmly do you feel toward someone who holds the view expressed by the other participant? (0 = very cold/unfavourable, 50 = no feeling either way, 100 = very warm/favourable)",

```

### Believability check (human-facilitator conditions only)

Only shown in `condition %in% c("control_human", "bridging_human")`.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var   = c("experiment_post_survey.1.player.human_fac_believability",
            "experiment_post_survey.1.player.human_fac_suspicion"),
  type  = c("Integer", "String"),
  range = c("1–5", "3 levels"),
  desc  = c(
    "To what extent did you believe the facilitator messages were written by a real human being?",
    "At any point during the study, did you suspect that the human facilitator might actually be an AI?"
  ),
  notes = c("1 = Not at all, 5 = Completely; blank for AI conditions",
            "yes / no / unsure; blank for AI conditions")
))
```

### GAAIS — General Attitudes towards AI Scale (1–5)

General Attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence Scale (Schepman & Rodway, 2020).
Scale: 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var = paste0("experiment_post_survey.1.player.gaais_",
               c(paste0("pos_", 1:12), paste0("neg_", 1:8))),
  type  = rep("Integer", 20),
  range = rep("1–5", 20),
  desc  = c(
    "For routine transactions, I would rather interact with an artificially intelligent system than with a human.",
    "Artificial Intelligence can provide new economic opportunities for this country.",
    "Artificially intelligent systems can help people feel happier.",
    "I am impressed by what Artificial Intelligence can do.",
    "I am interested in using artificially intelligent systems in my daily life.",
    "Artificial Intelligence can have positive impacts on people's wellbeing.",
    "Artificial Intelligence is exciting.",
    "An artificially intelligent agent would be better than an employee in many routine jobs.",
    "There are many beneficial applications of Artificial Intelligence.",
    "Artificially intelligent systems can perform better than humans.",
    "Much of society will benefit from a future full of Artificial Intelligence.",
    "I would like to use Artificial Intelligence in my own job.",
    "Organisations use Artificial Intelligence unethically.",
    "I think artificially intelligent systems make many errors.",
    "I find Artificial Intelligence sinister.",
    "Artificial Intelligence might take control of people.",
    "I think Artificial Intelligence is dangerous.",
    "I shiver with discomfort when I think about future uses of Artificial Intelligence.",
    "People like me will suffer if Artificial Intelligence is used more and more.",
    "Artificial Intelligence is used to spy on people."
  ),
  notes = c(rep("Positive subscale", 12), rep("Negative subscale", 8))
))
```

### AI experience

### Algorithmic aversion (1–5 Likert)

Scale: 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree.

```{r}
cb(data.frame(
  var = paste0("experiment_post_survey.1.player.algo_aversion_", 1:3),
  type  = rep("Integer", 3),
  range = rep("1–5", 3),
  desc  = c(
    "I generally prefer human facilitators over AI facilitators in online discussions.",
    "I would trust a human more than an AI to handle conflicts fairly in online conversations.",
    "I feel more comfortable when humans, rather than AI, moderate online discussions."
  ),
  notes = rep("", 3)
))
```

## Notes on reverse-coding

The following item should be reverse-coded before computing scale scores:

```{r}
kable(data.frame(
  Variable = "fac_intrusiveness",
  Item = "The facilitator's intervention felt disruptive to the conversation.",
  Formula = "fac_intrusiveness_r = 6 - fac_intrusiveness"
), align = "l") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## References

Schepman, A., & Rodway, P. (2020). Initial validation of the General Attitudes towards Artificial Intelligence Scale. *Computers in Human Behavior Reports, 1*, 100014.

Thompson, E. R. (2007). Development and validation of an internationally reliable short-form of the Positive and Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS). *Journal of Cross-Cultural Psychology, 38*(2), 227–242.
